task: D9.15 quote-routes page uses Composite Manager /v1/overview as its only business read and fails closed without legacy fallback
decision: The quote-routes GET is manager-owned. Flask now calls /v1/overview and maps manager arbitrage paths, path groups, execution pools, versions, data quality and pipeline status into the existing quote-routes page DTO. The route no longer invokes legacy bootstrap, legacy surface loading, observation overview, opportunity scanner, scan-now, recent-attempt evidence merging or closed-loop group legacy builders. Manager unavailability, malformed hierarchy, invalid chain scope or missing required overview fields return HTTP 503 manager_read_failed with dataSource=manager. Anchor filtering is presentation-only and does not introduce a USD-depth or USDG/USDE admission rule.
changes: Added quote_routes_manager_page_payload as a pure manager overview to quote-routes DTO adapter

The adapter maps route symbols/addresses, stable routeKey, full V4 PoolKey, pool IDs, execution/preferred pools, overviewRoute, overviewProfit, signed PnL analysis and manager versions into the existing route DTO
The adapter maps manager arbitragePathGroups to existing closedLoopGroups with token references, paths, pool dependencies and manager-anchor borrowable semantics
The adapter preserves manager dataQuality and version fields, and supports presentation-only anchor filtering with unfilteredRouteCount
/api/dex/quote-routes now calls quote_routes_manager_page_payload unconditionally and returns 503 manager_read_failed on manager error

The quote-routes GET no longer calls legacy bootstrap, surface loader, dex_quote_routes_payload, observer snapshot, scan-now, recent attempt reads, observation overview or closed-loop group legacy builders
Updated assembly, workflow, payload-contract and architecture tests to inject the manager-only quote-routes DTO and lock the route boundary
Updated the current development plan, implementation handbook and manager API README with D9.15 behavior and evidence
